title: GESTALT (a wavefolder into PUMP, an SP-303 style compressor)
author: Robbie (master page plumbing adapted from Tone+FX by Digital Alchemy DSP; SETTINGS row adapted from digihealth by irpina)
description: GESTALT 5.2 for Digitone: a wavefolder into PUMP, an SP-303 Vinyl Sim-style levelling compressor, on everything the Digitone plays, on its own master page (FUNC+LFO, then LEFT/RIGHT to the page after the stock ones). A = FOLD: OFF, then the drive, from soft saturation to many folds; B = SHAPE: the fold's curve, morphing SINE, TRI, SQR, STEP, RIPL, WRAP, LEAN; C = TONE: a low-pass after the folder, 300 Hz to 16 kHz, OPEN; D = TOUCH: the drive follows the input's level (+ loud parts fold harder, - quiet parts), OFF in the middle; E = COMP: OFF, then threshold, ratio and make-up together; F = RATIO: AUTO, 2:1 to 20:1, LIMIT; G = REL: PUMP through GLUE to LEVEL; H = OUT: the chain's output, -32 to +6 dB. The folder has a fixed trim by FOLD; a 30 Hz high-pass in the detector; a soft limiter. Its page: the fold curve, bouncing with the output's level, the eight controls with units and a gain-reduction meter; YES cycles the big curve and a graph of the last 2.8 s of gain reduction. Press and turn for big steps; FUNC + turn snaps; FUNC + REC / STOP / PLAY copies, pastes, clears. SETTINGS > FX ANIMATION stills the page. Settings per pattern. With FOLD OFF, COMP OFF and OUT 0 dB it costs nothing. Core-dn1 4.0's insert audio: on every output, main outs, headphones and USB.
